---

## How to pay

1. Request a tool (HTTP POST /tools/{id} or MCP tools/call) without payment.
2. Server returns Payment Required (HTTP 402 or MCP isError) with price, Base, USDC, payTo.
3. Wallet signs USDC authorization (EIP-3009; buyer typically pays no gas — facilitator does).
4. Retry with signed proof: PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header or _meta["x402/payment"].
5. Server verifies via facilitator, runs tool or returns the pack ZIP, settles on Base, returns result + receipt.
6. No account, no Stripe, no API key for buyers.

Skill packs download the same way: GET /packs/{id} → 402 → pay → ZIP.

Same money on MCP and HTTP — different envelopes only.
Details: https://defifintechdirectory.com/how-to-pay.md
